subject: Economics
pacing_note: The IEB publishes no ATP equivalent; term placement and week spans are the DBE ATP pacing carried over as a default. IEB schools set their own pacing — treat weeks as advisory.
assessment_note: DBE SBA programmes, control-test scopes and exam structures are deliberately stripped: IEB assessment is specified by the IEB Subject Assessment Guidelines (see ../exam_guidelines/), which have not been ingested yet. Do not fall back to the CAPS exam_structure for IEB papers.
scope_deltas: SAG-stated content-scope differences vs the CAPS/DBE prescription are recorded in scope_deltas.json in this folder (hand-maintained, SAG-transcribed only; an empty ledger means 'not yet transcribed', never 'no differences').

topics.name: ECONOMICS: BASIC CONCEPTS & BASIC ECONOMIC PROBLEM
subtopics: Elements, branches and methods of Economics; Economics among the sciences
The scarcity problem; the basic processes (production, exchange, consumption)
Promotion or violation of human rights and the environment
topics.prior_knowledge: Grade 7-8 economics concepts: wants, needs, production process, exchange, consumption

topics.name: CIRCULAR FLOW AND QUANTITATIVE ELEMENTS
subtopics: Circular flow diagram; participants in an economy; closed vs open economy
Markets; flows of the variables; leakages and injections
GDP and GNI
topics.prior_knowledge: Needs and wants, factors of production, production and consumption, choice and decision-making, savings, markets

topics.name: BUSINESS CYCLES
subtopics: The phenomenon of business cycles; indicators
SA business cycles; time series composition; cyclical patterns
Exogenous and endogenous reasons; effects of business cycles
topics.prior_knowledge: Roles of participants in the economy, production and consumption, markets, economic growth, the scarcity problem

topics.name: DYNAMICS OF THE MARKET
subtopics: Value, price and utility
Perfect and imperfect markets; world markets (the effects of electronics)
Supply and demand; price formation; functions of markets
topics.prior_knowledge: Markets, demand and supply forces, drawing graphs from tables, laws of demand and supply, shifts, market equilibrium

topics.name: PUBLIC SECTOR INTERVENTION
subtopics: Methods of involvement: indirect taxes, subsidies, welfare
Maximum and minimum prices; production; minimum wages
topics.prior_knowledge: Roles of government, government revenue, the national budget, public goods

topics.name: PRODUCTION POSSIBILITY CURVE
subtopics: Phenomenon, choice and scarcity
PPC determined by internal and external factors
Consequences of inefficiencies
topics.prior_knowledge: Graphing; factors of production; consumption vs production; economic efficiency

topics.name: GROWTH, DEVELOPMENT AND GLOBALISATION
subtopics: Early economic development and emergence of trade: self-sufficiency, agriculture, barter, emergence of money
Evolution of markets: surplus production, trade and transport, specialisation of labour, mercantile/commercial law and business forms, technological progress, money and saving
Governments and market regulation: state involvement in trade, taxation, financing infrastructure investment
Industrial development: manufacturing, technological progress, mobilisation of energy, mechanisation
topics.prior_knowledge: Standard of living (Gr 8), markets in general, demand and supply, industry, economic development

topics.name: POPULATION AND LABOUR FORCE
subtopics: Population size and growth; natural growth rate; demographic cycle; projected growth and migration
The SA labour force: age distribution, numbers, unemployment, geographic distribution
Demand and supply for labour and their interaction in the labour market
topics.prior_knowledge: Inequality and poverty, education and skills, sustainable job opportunities, unemployment

topics.name: LABOUR RELATIONS
subtopics: Labour Relations Act: self-government, majorification, consultation
Labour rights and conventions: BCEA, LRA, COIDA
Collective bargaining: bargaining councils, labour unions, CCMA (conciliation, arbitration, mediation), workplace forums, labour courts
topics.prior_knowledge: Labour as a factor of production, households as owners of factors, government role in economic activity, trade unions

topics.name: UNEMPLOYMENT
subtopics: Nature of unemployment: numbers, unemployment rate, characteristics of SA unemployment
Causes and consequences of unemployment
Approaches to solve unemployment: growth of production, public works programmes, unemployment insurance
topics.prior_knowledge: Unemployment, labour as a factor of production, economically active population, income inequality, discrimination

topics.name: ECONOMIC REDRESS
subtopics: Economically marginalised groups
Redress and reconstruction: factors of production

Democratisation of economic procedures: labour legislation, public hearings, NEDLAC, self-regulating bodies, macro-economic adaptations (performance, employment, income inequality, poverty, stability)
topics.prior_knowledge: Factors of production; influence of the national budget (Gr 8); standard of living (Gr 8)
